name: NGC 2107 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 2107, a star cluster in the Magellanic Clouds, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc2107-hubble
story: Stars crowd together in NGC 2107, one of the Magellanic Cloud star clusters whose Hubble images astronomers have searched for signs of more than one generation of stars.

claims.text: NGC 2107 is a Magellanic Cloud star cluster imaged by Hubble in program GO 9891
Astronomers searched Hubble images of Magellanic Cloud clusters, NGC 2107 among them, for multiple stellar populations
